description_fill_in: Unique alphanumeric session identifier generated for each student conversation session with the ABES Student Support Help Desk.

Classification of the student interaction modality and complexity (query_type_1: Direct FAQ retrieval, query_type_2: Voice STT query, query_type_3: Conversational time-aware greeting, query_type_4: Multi-turn category exploration, query_type_5: Grievance or administrative escalation inquiry).
Classified domain intent corresponding to ABES Engineering College administrative and academic services (admissions, fees, exams, hostel, schedule, library, grievance).
Mathematical cosine similarity and intent classification confidence score produced by the Scikit-Learn TF-IDF vectorizer model (threshold: 0.25).
Binary escalation flag indicating whether human administrative intervention was triggered (0 = Query resolved autonomously by Help Desk, 1 = Escalated to Dean, HOD, or Student Grievance Cell).
Student satisfaction feedback score captured on a 5-point Likert scale upon query resolution (1 = Poor/Unsatisfied to 5 = Excellent/Highly Satisfied).
